svg.title: Security architecture for the DLI course Securing Agents with OpenShell and NemoClaw
svg.desc: Static artifact supply chain, hosting options, browser trust boundaries, and required service roles. Local development services are excluded. Conditional paths are dashed and sensitive flows are orange.
svg.text: Security architecture for the DLI course Securing Agents with OpenShell and NemoClaw
Static artifact, hosting options, and browser trust boundaries
Protected static release path
Static hosting options
Student-side browser runtime
Required services and conditional relay

polyline.title: source_to_ci: Git; proposed source and commit metadata; auth: developer identity and protected review; boundary: contributor to protected CI
ci_to_artifact: CI artifact build; validated static course bundle; auth: protected CI identity; boundary: build execution to release artifact

artifact_to_pages: immutable Pages artifact handoff; validated static course bundle and SHA-256 inventory; auth: protected deployment identity after human environment approval; boundary: reviewed release artifact to Pages host

artifact_to_launchable: pinned release vendoring; validated static course tree and launch registration; auth: protected course and runtime release identities; boundary: course release artifact to external runtime repository
pages_to_browser: HTTPS; static course pages and assets; auth: public or host-controlled page access; boundary: Pages host to learner device
launchable_to_browser: same-origin HTTPS bootstrap; versioned course pages, assets, and startup credential handoff; auth: launchable browser session; boundary: launchable host to learner browser
browser_to_models: HTTPS; learner API credential, prompts, and responses; auth: learner-provided bearer credential; boundary: learner browser to selected model service

browser_to_workers: HTTPS and WebSocket; static-hosted agent traffic or iframe model traffic; auth: caller bearer credential or access assertion; boundary: learner browser to separately deployed relay
workers_to_models: HTTPS; iframe-only model credential, prompts, and responses; auth: caller bearer credential; boundary: iframe relay to model service

workers_to_nemoclaw: HTTPS and WebSocket; static-hosted agent requests, events, and access assertion; auth: access assertion and gateway credential; boundary: static-host relay to required agent runtime

launchable_starts_nemoclaw: launchable control plane and same-origin HTTPS/WebSocket; NemoClaw startup and direct course route; auth: launchable identity and gateway credential; boundary: launchable host to colocated agent runtime

launchable_to_models: browser HTTPS using startup-provided credential; direct model requests from the launchable-hosted course; auth: learner credential from launchable startup; boundary: launchable-hosted learner browser to model service

rect.title: Git repository. static course source and release controls
Protected CI and review. validation, CodeQL, SCA, human approval
Validated static course. HTML, JavaScript, CSS, images, locale overlays
Primary: GitHub Pages. public course; GitLab supplies private previews
Alternative: co-located launchable. runtime repo vendors pinned course tab

text.tspan: runtime repo vendors pinned course tab

rect.title: Learner browser. static course UI and client-side workflows
Model service. default NVIDIA or presenter-selected compatible API
NemoClaw runtime. required agent, gateway, tools, and sandbox
Cross-origin relays. NemoClaw for Pages; models for iframes

svg.text: Flow register
Git repository → Protected CI and review
via Git · data: proposed source and commit metadata
auth: developer identity and protected review · boundary: contributor to protected CI
Protected CI and review → Validated static course
via CI artifact build · data: validated static course bundle
auth: protected CI identity · boundary: build execution to release artifact
Validated static course → Primary: GitHub Pages
via immutable Pages artifact handoff · data: validated static course bundle and SHA-256 inventory
auth: protected deployment identity after human environment approval · boundary: reviewed release artifact to Pages host
Validated static course → Alternative: co-located launchable
via pinned release vendoring · data: validated static course tree and launch registration
auth: protected course and runtime release identities · boundary: course release artifact to external runtime repository
Primary: GitHub Pages → Learner browser
via HTTPS · data: static course pages and assets
auth: public or host-controlled page access · boundary: Pages host to learner device
Alternative: co-located launchable → Learner browser
via same-origin HTTPS bootstrap · data: versioned course pages, assets, and startup credential handoff
auth: launchable browser session · boundary: launchable host to learner browser
Learner browser → Model service
via HTTPS · data: learner API credential, prompts, and responses
auth: learner-provided bearer credential · boundary: learner browser to selected model service
Learner browser → Cross-origin relays
via HTTPS and WebSocket · data: static-hosted agent traffic or iframe model traffic
auth: caller bearer credential or access assertion · boundary: learner browser to separately deployed relay
Cross-origin relays → Model service (conditional)
via HTTPS · data: iframe-only model credential, prompts, and responses
auth: caller bearer credential · boundary: iframe relay to model service
Cross-origin relays → NemoClaw runtime
via HTTPS and WebSocket · data: static-hosted agent requests, events, and access assertion
auth: access assertion and gateway credential · boundary: static-host relay to required agent runtime
Alternative: co-located launchable → NemoClaw runtime
via launchable control plane and same-origin HTTPS/WebSocket · data: NemoClaw startup and direct course route
auth: launchable identity and gateway credential · boundary: launchable host to colocated agent runtime
Alternative: co-located launchable → Model service
via browser HTTPS using startup-provided credential · data: direct model requests from the launchable-hosted course
auth: learner credential from launchable startup · boundary: launchable-hosted learner browser to model service
Solid blue: ordinary flow · orange: sensitive flow · dashed: conditional browser path · design and regeneration instructions: docs/security-design.md
